summary.headline: Anthropic ships cheaper Claude Opus 5.5; Guterres urges AI risk framework
summary.body: Two steady pushes. Anthropic released Claude Opus 5.5 at prices 20% below Opus 5, claiming near-top performance; cheaper, stronger models raise Capability Velocity, which lifts Enslaved God and Descendants and lowers Reversion. In his final UN General Assembly address, Secretary-General Guterres urged leading AI nations to share safety-risk information and build a multilateral risk framework with independent oversight. That supports Global Coordination, the main driver of Gatekeeper, and eases Self-Destruction. Bright and dark endings rose by similar amounts, leaving Horizon Balance almost unchanged at -5.78. Gatekeeper, helped by both stories at once, was the day's biggest gainer.
summary.movers_note: Gatekeeper +0.4, mostly from the Opus 5.5 launch (+0.25) and Guterres's UN appeal (+0.17). Reversion -0.3, from the Opus 5.5 launch (-0.37), partly offset by fading earlier news (+0.03). Enslaved God +0.3, from the Opus 5.5 launch (+0.37), partly offset by fading earlier news (-0.05).

events.title: Guterres uses final UNGA address to urge multilateral AI risk framework
events.summary: UN Secretary-General Guterres told the General Assembly that leading AI nations must share safety-risk information and work toward a multilateral AI risk-management framework with independent oversight.
events.reason: UN leader call; words not action.
